texts.preamble: Smt Archana Patil vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 July, 2025 Author: Maninder S. Bhatti Bench: Maninder S. Bhatti Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:32270 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur Before Hon'Ble Shri Justice Maninder S. Bhatti On The 17th Of July, 2025 Writ Petition No. 26309 of 2025 Smt Archana Patil Versus The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others Appearance:
texts.facts: ORDER This is a petition assailing the order dated 09/06/2025 (Annexure P/1) by which the petitioner who is working as Auxiliary Nurse Midwife is being sought to be transferred from Urban Primary Health Center, Vinobanagar, Betul District Betul (wrongly mentioned as Urban Primary Health Center Ambedkar Ward) to Chief Medical and Health Officer District Narmadapuram. 2. The said request was acceded which ensued passing of order dated 07/07/2023 (Annexure P/2). Thus, the impugned order dated 09/06/20254 has been issued in complete violation of Clause 23 of the transfer policy.
texts.arguments: Counsel for the petitioner contends that previously the petitioner made an application for transfer on her own expenses as his husband is also working as Food Safety Officer at Betul. It is contended by the counsel that by NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:32270 2 WP-26309-2025 highlighting her grievance the petitioner has already moved a representation (Annexure P/7) dated 13/06/2025 therefore, prays that the authority concerned be directed to consider and decide the same in accordance with law. 3. The counsel for the State submits that the impugned order has been passed in view of the administrative exigency, however, the representation of the petitioner shall be dealt with in accordance with law.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Counsel for the petitioner contends that previously the petitioner made an application for transfer on her own expenses as his husband is also working as Food Safety Officer at Betul. It is contended by the counsel that by NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:32270 2 WP-26309-2025 highlighting her grievance the petitioner has already moved a representation (Annexure P/7) dated 13/06/2025 therefore, prays that the authority concerned be directed to consider and decide the same in accordance with law. 3. The counsel for the State submits that the impugned order has been passed in view of the administrative exigency, however, the representation of the petitioner shall be dealt with in accordance with law.
